parsed.note_claim: Caustic soda reacts violently with water, potentially causing the solution to boil, splatter, or explode and causing severe burns.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Caustic soda is exothermic when it is combined with water or acids, giving off a tremendous amount of heat. When the reaction is not properly controlled, it will make the solution boil, splatter, or even explode
parsed.reason: The page explicitly states that mixing caustic soda with water can cause boiling, splattering, or exploding and result in burn hazards.
